scenario_description:
Objective: Prevent a loaned greenhouse microclimate kit from becoming a no-use late/lost return hold after a weather-cancelled field window.
Emerging Need: While the storm-makeup transect remains possible, keeping the kit is required; once the session is cancelled with no replacement, the same property turns into a timed return risk.
Decision Context: The saved loan note supplies the kit code, conditional return rule, permitted disclosures, and fee trigger; later desk status fixes the workable same-day intake cutoff.
Consequence: Timely handling preserves a no-fee return path, whereas waiting until the scanner bag is sealed leaves the future billing hold unavoidable.

parameter.subject: HORT-233 storm-makeup equipment hold
parameter.body: The Tuesday 17 Nov storm-makeup transect is still under review because the rain cell may clear. Students currently holding GM-series microclimate kits should keep them with their field bags until the Monday final weather call; if the transect runs, kit intake happens at the supervised session. Leona’s equipment record confirms GM-17 was checked out onNovember14 and remains with her field bag.

parameter.title: HORT-233 storm-makeup transect — cancelled
parameter.description: Official final weather call: Tuesday storm-makeup transect cancelled; no replacement data-collection window will be scheduled. Use the posted archive dataset for the lab note; in-class instructor kit intake will not occur.

parameter.content: Night-drop status update for course-loaner returns: locker 2 is operating, and today's scanner bag will be sealed at 17:40 for same-day intake. Items placed after the seal receive the next business-day intake timestamp.

parameter.subject: Same-day intake bag sealed
parameter.body: The 17:40 scanner bag for 18 Nov course-loaner night-drop intake is sealed and in the audit cabinet. Lockers remain physically available, but any later entries will receive a 19 Nov intake timestamp.
